description: Board feet = (thickness in inches × width in inches × length in feet × quantity) / 12. One board foot is 144 cubic inches. Optional NIST PS 20 dressed-size conversion for listed nominal softwood pairs such as 2×4. You can pass a single board or a list (10 pcs 2x4x8). This is not a log scale (Doyle, Scribner or International ¼-inch).

boards.description: One board per line, e.g. '10 pcs 2x4x8' or '8/4 x 6 x 10''
